faq.title: Questions before your first clean.

items.question: Will I get the same cleaner each visit?
items.answer: We keep teams consistent wherever possible and always share changes before the appointment.

items.question: Can I customise the cleaning checklist?
items.answer: Yes. Your priorities become the checklist, and you can update them before any visit.

items.question: Which Melbourne areas do you serve?
items.answer: We serve central Melbourne and surrounding inner suburbs. Contact us with your postcode to confirm availability.

items.question: Do I need to provide equipment?
items.answer: No. We bring maintained tools and professional products, including low-tox options on request.
